title: Aladdin and the Magic Lamp
author: Les Mille et Une Nuits
desc: Un garçon pauvre, une lampe magique, un génie… et un sorcier très méchant.

p: In a city in China, there lived a poor boy called Aladdin. His father was dead, and his mother worked very hard. Aladdin was lazy. He played in the street all day.
One day, a man came to him. "I am your uncle," he said. "Your father's brother. I want to help you."
But he was not his uncle. He was an evil magician from Africa.
The magician took Aladdin far outside the city, to the mountains. He said magic words. The ground opened, and there was a stone with a ring.
"Go down," said the magician. "Inside, there is a garden with fruits of gold. Don't touch anything. Bring me only the old lamp. Here, take this ring for protection."
Aladdin went down. He saw trees with fruits of diamonds, emeralds and rubies. He filled his pockets. At the end, he found the old lamp.
"Give me the lamp!" shouted the magician from above.
"Help me get out first!" said Aladdin.
The magician was furious. He said a magic word, and the stone closed. Aladdin was trapped in the dark.
He cried for three days. Then he rubbed his hands together… and he rubbed the ring. Whoosh! A genie appeared!
"I am the Genie of the Ring. What do you wish?"
"Take me home!" said Aladdin. And in a second, he was home.
His mother wanted to sell the old lamp. She started to clean it. Whoosh! A gigantic genie came out!
"I am the Genie of the Lamp! I am the slave of whoever holds this lamp. What do you wish?"
Aladdin's life changed. He asked for food, then for gold, then for beautiful clothes.
One day, he saw the Sultan's daughter, Princess Badroulbadour. She was the most beautiful woman in the world. Aladdin fell in love.

With the genie's help, he sent the Sultan forty golden plates of jewels, carried by forty servants. The Sultan was impressed. In one night, the genie built a palace of gold and marble for Aladdin. And Aladdin married the princess.
But the magician heard about Aladdin's palace. He understood: Aladdin had the lamp!
When Aladdin was out hunting, the magician walked under the palace windows. "New lamps for old! New lamps for old!"
The princess did not know the secret. She laughed and gave him the old lamp from Aladdin's room.
The magician rubbed it. "Genie, take the palace and the princess to Africa!" And the palace disappeared.
Aladdin came back. Nothing! He used the Genie of the Ring to go to Africa. He found the princess. She put a sleeping powder in the magician's wine. When he slept, Aladdin took back the lamp.
The palace flew home, and Aladdin and the princess lived happily for many years. And Aladdin was never lazy again.
